projects.title: Sales performance dashboard for a consumer-goods distributor
projects.problem: regional managers waited a week for an Excel pack that was already out of date
projects.approach: a star-schema model refreshed daily with a Power BI report per region and row-level security
outcomes: reporting lag from 7 days to 1 day
used weekly by 60 managers
projects.review: our managers finally look at the same numbers

projects.title: dbt transformation layer on Snowflake
projects.problem: every analyst wrote their own revenue query and none of them matched
projects.approach: a tested dbt project with staging, intermediate and mart layers and one definition of revenue
outcomes: one certified revenue metric replaced 9 conflicting queries
data test coverage on all mart models

projects.title: Customer churn analysis for a subscription box
projects.problem: the team knew churn was rising but not which customers or why
projects.approach: cohort retention curves, survival analysis by acquisition channel and a Tableau story for leadership
outcomes: identified a discount channel with 2x churn, which was paused
12-month retention up 6 points the next quarter
projects.review: clear story that changed our acquisition budget

projects.title: Demand forecast for a pharmacy chain
projects.problem: pharmacies ran out of seasonal medicines during flu season
projects.approach: weekly SKU forecasts with Ramadan and flu-season effects, exported to the purchasing team's Excel template
outcomes: stock-outs on top 200 SKUs down 35%
forecast error (WAPE) from 28% to 16%

projects.title: Marketing attribution and campaign ROI analysis
projects.problem: the marketing team credited every sale to the last click
projects.approach: GA4 raw-event export to BigQuery, a data-driven attribution model and a campaign ROI dashboard
outcomes: shifted 20% of spend from branded search to prospecting
blended ROAS up 14% over the next two months
projects.review: we stopped arguing about which channel works

projects.title: Financial model and board reporting for a fintech
projects.problem: the CFO rebuilt the board pack by hand every month
projects.approach: a driver-based three-statement model linked to the warehouse with scenario toggles and an automated board pack
outcomes: board pack preparation from 4 days to half a day
unit economics by cohort for the Series A data room
projects.review: investors complimented the model in diligence

projects.title: Web scraping-free price monitoring with official APIs
projects.problem: manual competitor price checks covered only 50 products
projects.approach: a daily pipeline that pulls partner product feeds through their official APIs, validates them and charts price moves
outcomes: coverage from 50 to 8,000 products
pricing decisions reviewed daily instead of monthly
projects.review: solid pipeline that runs every morning without babysitting

projects.title: Operations KPI dashboard for a ride-hailing fleet
projects.problem: supply and demand were matched by gut feeling across 40 zones
projects.approach: a geospatial dashboard of supply, demand and wait times by zone and hour with alerting on gaps
outcomes: average rider wait time down 18%
dashboard adopted by 25 zone managers
projects.review: zone managers check it every shift

projects.title: A/B test analysis framework for a mobile game
projects.problem: game designers shipped changes on tests that had not reached significance
projects.approach: a reusable notebook and SQL templates for power analysis, CUPED variance reduction and sequential testing guardrails
outcomes: test duration cut by about 30% with CUPED
two false-positive launches prevented in the first quarter
projects.review: our designers understand p-values now, sort of

projects.title: HR attrition analytics for a BPO
projects.problem: agent attrition was 60% a year and exit reasons were never analysed
projects.approach: combined HRIS, attendance and survey data into an attrition dashboard with drivers by team lead
outcomes: identified two team leads driving a third of exits
annualised attrition down to 47% in nine months
projects.review: gave us facts for hard conversations

projects.title: Data warehouse migration from spreadsheets to BigQuery
projects.problem: the company ran on 40 linked Google Sheets that broke weekly
projects.approach: ingested operational sources into BigQuery, modelled them in dbt and rebuilt the key reports in Looker Studio
outcomes: retired 40 spreadsheets
report refresh from manual weekly to automatic hourly

projects.title: Survey analysis and segmentation for a market research agency
projects.problem: a 5,000-respondent survey needed segments the client could act on
projects.approach: weighted responses, factor analysis on attitude questions and k-means segments with personas
outcomes: five segments adopted in the client's brand strategy
report delivered three days ahead of deadline
projects.review: segments were intuitive and backed by data

projects.title: Inventory and supplier analytics in Excel and Power Query
projects.problem: buyers did not know which suppliers were late or which stock was dead
projects.approach: an automated Excel model with supplier on-time scores and ABC/XYZ inventory classification
outcomes: dead stock identified worth about PKR 18M
supplier on-time delivery up from 71% to 86%
projects.review: simple tool that the buyers actually use

projects.title: Product analytics instrumentation for a SaaS app
projects.problem: the product team could not say where trial users dropped off
projects.approach: designed an event taxonomy, fixed tracking gaps and built activation and retention funnels
outcomes: found an onboarding step losing 38% of trials
trial-to-paid conversion up from 9% to 13%

projects.title: Credit portfolio monitoring dashboard for a microfinance bank
projects.problem: portfolio-at-risk was calculated monthly in Excel and often wrong
projects.approach: automated PAR, roll-rate and vintage analysis with a Power BI dashboard for the risk committee
outcomes: PAR reporting from monthly to daily
regulatory report errors reduced to zero in two audits
projects.review: our risk committee relies on it

projects.title: Geospatial analysis of store locations
projects.problem: new stores were opened on landlord recommendations
projects.approach: catchment analysis combining census density, competitor locations and existing store sales to score sites
outcomes: ranked 120 candidate sites
first two recommended stores beat sales targets by 22%

projects.title: Automated weekly KPI emails with Python
projects.problem: an analyst spent every Monday copying numbers into an email
projects.approach: a scheduled script that queries the database, renders charts and sends a templated KPI email
outcomes: saved about 5 hours of analyst time a week
report sent at 8 am every Monday without fail

projects.title: Pricing elasticity study for an online grocery
projects.problem: discounts were set by intuition and margins were shrinking
projects.approach: estimated price elasticity by category with controls for promotions and seasonality and simulated margin impact
outcomes: recommended price changes lifted gross margin 1.8 points in the test categories
discount depth reduced on inelastic categories
projects.review: the elasticity numbers paid for the project quickly
